name: Big N Blind Bangalore March 2026

venue.name: Jus'Trufs Chocolate Shop & Cafe

information: * All participants must be present for the entire duration of the competition irrespective of the number of events. * All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event. * Only one guest per participant is allowed owing to space constraints in the venue.
